mappings.assertion: TestS1SizeGuard fails if the claim_reviewer_task.go file key or the claimReviewerTask, ClearStaleReviewClaims or updateReviewCommitLocked key is still in area_a5_test.go's ratchet while the code is over the limit, and fails if any remaining key grows. All four keys are removed and the A5 ratchet is empty. claimReviewerTask is an orchestrator over reviewerClaim: loadPolicy, attempt and attemptUnderTaskLock around transaction, which runs snapshotCandidates and eligibleCandidates (reviewer_claim_selection.go), selectBestCandidate, claimCandidate (deferUnsettledHeal, checkBoundary: reviewer_claim_candidate.go), claim and assign (claim effects), and claimFailure (the candidate-failure envelope). ClearStaleReviewClaims is detectStaleReviewClaim over clearStaleReviewClaim. updateReviewCommitLocked is reviewCommitUpdate: checkPreconditions, readWorktreeBoundary, prepareAcceptance and apply (recordRepair). claim_reviewer_task.go is under 800 lines.

TestOracleA5Supplement compares the state and result captures of OH1 (a proven orphaned-base heal: boundary republished onto the moved integration head, the submitted commit replayed), OH2 (a replay conflict routed to INTEGRATION_FAILED with the worktree restored to the submitted commit) and OH3 (a heal preparation whose effect is neither proven nor absent, fenced for inspection) against goldens committed in e49287414 before any production edit, generated by regen write-new on the unchanged tree through the exported HealOrphanedReviewBase. TestSupplementGoldenCoverage pins coverage; regen -mode check -pkg ./internal/oracle/a5/... reproduces every golden.

The claim, diversity, stale-claim and update white-box tests (claim_reviewer_task_test.go, claim_reviewer_slot_test.go, claim_reviewer_lifecycle_test.go, claim_reviewer_lifecycle_preflight_test.go, orphaned_review_base_claim_test.go, orphaned_review_base_test.go, clear_stale_review_claims_test.go, update_review_commit_test.go) keep every assertion unchanged and run under the race detector against the split code. TestReviewerClaimFailureEnvelopeSelectsErrorByPrecedence pins the extracted candidate-failure envelope (acceptance evidence before repair-needed before boundary mismatch, repair-needed tasks named once) and TestReviewCommitUpdateRequireRepairableStatus the extracted status precondition shared by the snapshot and the final transaction. The C2 comparisons (pickWithApprovalDiversity, pickWithFreshDiversity, filterDoerProviderDiversity, isBlockedByDoerDiversity) moved verbatim and are asserted by TestClaimReviewerTask_DiversityWithApprovals and TestClaimReviewerTask_DiversityFreshSubmissions.

TestReviewOwnershipNamedValuesKeepTheirSpelling pins each K-OWN named value against the literal it replaced: the claim, update and heal operation labels, the six review_commit_updated history Extra keys, the review-boundary phase, the claim and git operation codes, the validation codes (candidate_changed, context_changed, worktree_unavailable), the actor constants, the OrphanedBaseHealOutcome values, LifecycleEffectsNone and the 60 s claim cooldown. ReviewClaimClass (A3) and OrphanedBaseHealOutcome are adopted unchanged; no second type is defined, and the claim lease still derives from LeaseDuration in claimReviewerTask.

TestOracleA5 compares the delivered A5 goldens live (RC1-RC5, UR1-UR2, CS1-CS2 among them, RC1 with its <lease:+30m> lease, RC4 under the current diversity rule); none changes (git diff of internal/oracle/a5/testdata/golden and of the older supplement goldens against the starting commit is empty).

TestS1SizeGuard enforces that area_a5_test.go ratchet keys only shrink: the K-OWN keys (claim_reviewer_task.go file, claimReviewerTask, ClearStaleReviewClaims, updateReviewCommitLocked) are gone, the A5 ratchet is empty, and no key was added or raised.
test target (go test ./...) runs the ops, archguard and A5 oracle suites including the new tests; lint, test-e2e and the race run are mandatory with it.
